mr_title: Moved Index system checks from Model to Index.check().

expected_issues.title: Descending index fields ('-name') reported as nonexistent
expected_issues.description:
The moved check passes self.fields to _check_local_fields(), but descending index fields keep their '-' prefix there, so Index(fields=['-created']) is reported as referring to a nonexistent field (models.E012).

The Model-level check that was removed iterated over index.fields_orders, which strips the '-' ordering prefix. The new Index.check() uses the raw self.fields, so a perfectly valid descending index now fails `manage.py check` with 'indexes refers to the nonexistent field -created'. Field names must come from fields_orders.
